obligation: Compare closed defined types by recursive group identity and follow declared ancestry across module-local indices; expand non-final/grouped block function types without erasing callable identity.
representation: WasmTypes remains the single declaration authority. Equivalence compares whole group shape/member position, finality, supertype/descriptor edges, shared flags, nullability, exact/concrete/abstract heap forms, numeric/packed field kinds, mutability and all function parameters/results. Group-local references normalize by member position; preceding-group references enqueue their origin pair, visited once. External and local references remain distinct, including cases with equal infinite unfoldings. Worklist traversal avoids native recursion and repeated diamond expansion. Defined-type subtyping follows declared ancestry using this equivalence; ancestry traversal is bounded by the declaration count. Block function_shape is a projection from the same facts; callable function admission remains guarded. No stored canonical cache, new opcode, Value/cell, executor or residual format.
scope: The prior 210-file affected decoded-module inventory, the prior 3212 focused controls, and 19 new block-type directives. No complete pinned suite replay or Test262 replay; no OXC semantic/dispatch operation changes.

controls.obligations: Non-final and multi-member recursive function declarations used as scalar block and if signatures; both if arms, shifted declaration indices, and signed I32 wrapping boundaries. Previous numeric/resource/call/root controls retain all passes.

checks.new_internal_obligation: 2048 all-pair canonical equality and declared-ancestry checks from 32 types in 20 independently validated modules, against IDs and ancestor chains from one reused wasmparser validator. Covers index renaming, whole-group membership/order, local versus external references, nullability, field mutability/packed widths, finality, supertypes and function params/results. Separate shifted 1024-declaration duplicate-edge chains agree with validator IDs and complete without recursive matching. Out-of-range indices fail closed. This internal representation oracle is not ordinary suite-conformance coverage.

limitations: Type operations and block expansion are qualified foundations. Functions still need explicit declared-type identity binding before imported/indirect calls can admit recursive/non-final callable types. Typed/nullability value guards, concrete/GC reference values, GC allocation/operators, typed reference/tail calls, exceptions and full-inventory closure remain open. Shared/descriptor/continuation comparisons preserve their fields but are not newly admitted or comprehensively oracle-qualified. The affected pinned inventory still has 969 failures; Stage A and production cutover/cleanup remain open. No performance claim.
